skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply research methodologies learned in the curriculum to solve practical problems at internship sites.
Identify, analyze, and resolve issues arising in business travel and tourism management.
Collect and process relevant data related to practical problems at internship sites.
Manage situations that arise during administrative operations in travel and tourism businesses.
Perform practical tasks assigned by internship sites.
Effectively present graduation thesis before a panel.
Work collaboratively with peers and supervisors.
Demonstrate leadership qualities in managing practical projects.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve practical problems.
Maintain self-motivation and discipline throughout the internship period.
Adhere to ethical standards and legal requirements in research and practice.
